description: Show your World of Warcraft: Forever character: gear, stats, professions, reputations, talents and more

achievements.description: The latest achievements, with their icon and date
achievements.name: Achievements

character.description: Name and surname, or the character's armory link (Blizzard's or wowforeverdata.com)
character.label: Character
character.tooltip: Forever characters have no realm: the name and the surname identify one per region. Blizzard shows a character from level 10, after it logs out, and draws its picture some hours later.

character_image.description: The full-body render (about 300 KB in the card), the portrait (4 KB) or no picture
character_image.label: Picture

region.description: The region the character plays in. Any region searches all four; Blizzard's armory link sets it on its own.
region.label: Region

character.description: Your character's render, level, race, class, guild and item level
character.name: Character

dungeons.description: Dungeon bosses defeated, and how many times
dungeons.name: Dungeons

equipment_max.description: Items in slot order, from the head down to the weapons. Shirt, tabard and ammo are left out.
equipment_max.label: Maximum items

equipment_show_icons.description: Each item's icon in a frame of its quality color (about 2 KB each)
equipment_show_icons.label: Show item icons

equipment.description: The items the character wears, with their quality and item level
equipment.name: Equipment

journey.description: Lifetime numbers: kills, deaths, quests, dungeons, flight paths and more
journey.name: Journey

professions.description: Primary and secondary professions, with their skill
professions.name: Professions

reputations.description: Standing with each faction, the highest first
reputations.name: Reputations

stats.description: Health, power, primary attributes and armor
stats.name: Attributes

talents.description: Points spent in each talent tree of the active specialization
talents.name: Talents
